env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^logos-facts 3$'
stdout '^fingerprint [0-9a-f]{16}$'
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'

env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af-wasm.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-wasm.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
cd af
logos build -O=0 -o $WORK/af-o0.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-o0.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
cd af
logos build -O=3 -o $WORK/af-o3.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-o3.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOARCH=386
cd af
logos build -o $WORK/af-386.a .
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-386.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'
env GOARCH=
cd af
go tool compile -p example.com/af -o $WORK/af-go.a af.lgo
cd ..
go tool pack p $WORK/af-go.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn F AssertTP=1,AssertRTP=0$'

-- af/go.mod --
module example.com/af

go 1.27

	}
